known_limitations: HEADLINE FINDING (frozen engine semantics, needs an owner decision): the two gross-1.0 books (ILLIQ, PREMFADE) deterministically leave their LAST short unfilled in the production executor. The frozen no-leverage guard (accounting.apply_fill: opening sell refused when gross_after > equity + 1e-9) compares against equity already reduced by this rebalance's fee/slippage (~30-60 USDT on 100k), while the book sizes on start-of-rebalance equity at gross exactly 1.0. Result: 7/8 fills, accounting_status UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED, gross ~0.8755. This is the executor's DESIGNED, TESTED behavior (tests/test_shv1_executor.py::test_opening_short_still_fails_cash_checks_when_headroom_insufficient) and the G8 remediation explicitly froze 'no execution buffer, no sell slicing' (ADJ3). This lane cannot and does not modify the frozen engine; the E phase would observe this tail-refusal every weekly decision unless an owner-authorized engine remediation lane (e.g. cost-aware sizing or a declared tolerance) is dispatched. CARRY (gross 0.80) is unaffected.

F1/F2 candidate universes are declared by this worker (20 ILLIQ bars candidates; 13 PREMFADE basis pairs): the identity manifests deliberately do NOT enumerate the historical staged symbol lists (P2 data manifest: 'This lane invents no symbol list'). Composition mirrors the Q-smoke candidates plus major deep USDT-M perps, all verified TRADING PERPETUAL in the archived exchangeInfo; PIT listing+DV eligibility is still resolved per decision by the adapters. PREMFADE is sized to the frozen eligibility band (min_eligible 12; the min_abs_weight 0.125 cap admits only n_eligible 12-14, so a larger universe would be risk-blocked by the frozen caps).

ILLIQ engine numeric thresholds (identity pins the rules, not numbers): min_listing_age_days 27.0 (largest whole-day value decidable from the fetch window; any threshold >= the window auto-rejects every symbol because listing evidence is the first bar in the snapshot), min_daily_dollar_volume 10,000,000 USDT trailing mean, btc_beta_tolerance 1e-6. ILLIQ btc_betas use the STRUCTURAL-BETA convention (unit betas: the frozen btc_beta_neutral cap verifies the equal-count long/short mirror, book beta exactly 0); no measured 90d daily beta surface exists in this lane's scope - an owner tightening before/at activation.

Snapshot fetch lookbacks are 29d+1h for the two 28d families: the identity's 28d is the formation COUNT (2688 = 28x96 trailing completed buckets; 28 daily returns + 1 base day) and a literal 28d window yields only 2678 completed buckets after the C6 cutoff - every decision would be DATA_BLOCKED. The adapters re-enforce the exact trailing-2688/29-date identity and 29d max span; the extra window is transport only. Same sizing as the Q-lane smoke (29 days).

PREMFADE/CARRY LINEAGE_COST books mirror CURRENT_CONSERVATIVE_COST: their identity entries pin no numeric lineage fee/slippage (verbatim conventions are structural: the fill rule and the funding sign/cadence). ILLIQ's LINEAGE book realizes its verbatim stress convention (fee x1.5, +2 ticks) on the frozen 0.0005 base.

PacedFetch adds transport pacing/retry (min gap 0.25s, <= 6 attempts, Retry-After honoured) through the frozen client's official fetch_fn injection point only; endpoints, bytes, allowlist and PIT semantics are untouched. After the retry cap a failure still surfaces honestly as DATA_BLOCKED (a consumed event_id).

The rehearsal evidence and the three replay ledgers committed under e/replay_rehearsal/ are REPLAY_NOT_PROSPECTIVE bytes: evidence of engine rehearsal, NOT prospective observations. They are labeled as such (sidecar label files + evidence fields).
